count_semantics: Six QEMU evidence groups. Assertions are audit comparisons, not USB test cases. Each group contains two real I/O cycles in two guest processes.
boundaries: Does not import or call any runner verify/pcap_review. External capture security review is assigned separately; this report does not independently certify the capture.
125 source inputs per group checked against exact b83c931 Git blobs, immutable originals and real guest /proc executable hashes; documentation commits must not reattribute runtime evidence.
Physical denotes QEMU emulated HID/FTDI. No hardware G1/G2, complete Phase 2, full Phase 3, revocation, adversarial certificate, crash/restart or backpressure acceptance claim.
Contender evidence is a catalog-unavailable refusal with unchanged occupied client rows, not a direct competing IMPORT transaction.

USBFS retains its final empty physical journal here; no intermediate physical journal snapshots were captured in these runs, so immutable physical grant fields during each cycle are not independently re-audited here. Native import and Native export/stub held/released journals are retained and compared.
USBFS protocol counters include nonzero errors from handled requests/cancellation; no claim of zero USB protocol errors. Exact actual payload bytes and verified release are checked.
No local postmortem USB operation. LocalGone is the guest assertion corroborated by raw kernel disconnects, allNULL rows and distinct fresh import generations.
No instrumentation proves a particular Native initialization Pending branch executed; all 24 actual imports succeeded without prior NotFound or cleanup-unconfirmed output.
Original earlier failed runs remain unchanged and distinct from this clean six-group batch.
